text:
Priya Nair: quick sync — onboarding flow for tenant admins. getting a lot of support requests: people confuse 'route scope' vs 'model scope' in the role editor. want to converge copy + an API shape we can rely on. thoughts?
Alex Chen: totally. +1 on making the console language match the API. users scan for 'models' not 'routes' so we should call out both but emphasize primary intent.
Jon Park: what if we surface two distinct dropdowns: Primary scope (Model / Route / All) and Secondary filters (route prefix, model tags). keep the role object simple in the API.
Tess Rivera: my worry is complexity during onboarding. most users just want a simple 'read'/'write' toggle scoped to a product. granular filters can be "advanced". also let's avoid 'scope' as the only term — it's overloaded. maybe 'Access target' in the UI?
Priya Nair: good call. proposal: default wizard shows: Access target -> (Entire Tenant | Model | Route). selecting Model asks for model selector; selecting Route asks for route pattern. advanced option expands to include quotas and telemetry flags.
Alex Chen: API sketch (for compatibility with current backend):
```json
POST /v1/tenants/:tid/roles
{
  "name": "Support - Model Reader",
  "permissions": ["generate:read"],
  "target": {
    "type": "model",
    "selector": {"ids": ["redwood-7b"], "tag": "stable"}
  },
  "advanced": {"quota": "100k_tokens/mo", "telemetry": "bounded"}
}
```
Jon Park: I like the `target` object. keeps role evaluation deterministic. maybe use `principal` only for who it grants to, keep `target` as what it grants access to.
Tess Rivera: UX microcopy: instead of 'selector' use 'models or tags' as label, and show inline help: "Select one or more models or tags this role can call." Add an example: `redwood-7b, local-finetune-v1`.
Priya Nair: also need enterprise controls: a tenant admin should be able to lock down "Allow advanced filters" at the tenant level. otherwise seat-admins might create crazy granular roles that break audit. we should add `tenant_settings.allow_advanced_role_filters` toggle.
Alex Chen: backend note: if the tenant setting is false, UI should hide the advanced section and API should reject requests that include `advanced` with 403. explicit is better than silent ignore.
infra-bot: deploy-bot queued a rollout for feature/role-target-api -> staging (PR #842). will post when migration script runs. :gear:
Jon Park: migration concern — existing roles use `scope: "model:redwood-7b"` string. we need a one-off migration that transforms to `target.type` + `selector.ids`. should be idempotent.
Tess Rivera: can we ship UI with a compatibility layer that reads old roles and displays them as targets, but writes back the new shape? that reduces support tickets.
Alex Chen: yep, compatibility reader + write-on-edit. migration script: find roles with `scope` string, parse on `:` into type+id, write new `target`. we'll include a dry-run mode.
Priya Nair: action items: @Alex implement API validator + 403 when tenant locked; @Jon write migration dry-run and post results; @Tess update console mockups and microcopy, add inline help; I'll draft a small admin banner copy for the tenant setting and share in #product for legal review.
Alex Chen: I can have validator + unit tests by EOD tomorrow.
Jon Park: I'll run migration dry-run on staging data Wednesday.
Tess Rivera: mockups by Friday, will include copy variants.
Priya Nair: perfect — thanks team. keeping this thread for the rollout checklist. @infra-bot ping when staging migration runs. :white_check_mark:
